description: This file defines the TbImageMap class, a specialized map component for rendering image-based maps with coordinate transformations, overlays, and data subscriptions within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: TbImageMap
classes.description: A map component for displaying image overlays with coordinate transformations, zoom, and bounds management.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Returns default map settings.

methods.name: createMap
methods.description: Initializes the map and loads image layer data.

methods.name: onResize
methods.description: Handles resizing of the map and updates bounds and overlays accordingly.

methods.name: fitBounds
methods.description: Placeholder for fitting map to bounds (empty implementation).

methods.name: locationDataToLatLng
methods.description: Converts location data coordinates to Leaflet LatLng.

methods.name: latLngToLocationData
methods.description: Converts Leaflet LatLng to location data coordinates.

methods.name: polygonDataToCoordinates
methods.description: Converts raw polygon data to coordinate arrays with coordinate transformation.

methods.name: coordinatesToPolygonData
methods.description: Converts coordinate arrays to raw polygon data with coordinate transformation.

methods.name: circleDataToCoordinates
methods.description: Converts circle data to coordinate form with coordinate transformation.

methods.name: coordinatesToCircleData
methods.description: Converts center point and radius to circle data with coordinate transformation.

methods.name: getAspect
methods.description: Returns the aspect ratio of the image layer.

methods.name: pointToLatLng
methods.description: Converts a point to Leaflet LatLng using CRS.

methods.name: latLngToPoint
methods.description: Converts Leaflet LatLng to a point using CRS.

methods.name: doCreateMap
methods.description: Creates the Leaflet map instance with specified options.

methods.name: updateMaxBounds
methods.description: Updates map bounds and overlays, manages map panning.

methods.name: loadImageLayerData
methods.description: Loads image layer data from URL or data source, manages subscriptions.

methods.name: imageFromUrl
methods.description: Loads an image and its aspect ratio from a URL.

methods.name: imageFromEntityData
methods.description: Processes entity data to load image and aspect ratio.

methods.name: polylineDataToCoordinates
methods.description: Converts raw polyline data to coordinate arrays with coordinate transformation.

methods.name: coordinatesToPolylineData
methods.description: Converts coordinate arrays to raw polyline data with coordinate transformation.
